heading: Revocation of commissions during first five years of commissioned service
lead: The Secretary, under such regulations as he may prescribe, may revoke the commission of any regular officer on active duty who, at the date of such revocation, has had less than five years of continuous service as a commissioned officer in the Regular Coast Guard.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 281 of this title as this section. 2002—Pub. L. 107–295 substituted “five” for “three” in section catchline and text.
